terms.latin: septimus decimus, septima decima, septimum decimum
terms.grammar: ordinal adjective, first and second declension; both parts decline
terms.comment: Lewis & Short has tertius, septimus with short vowels; Traupman’s tērtius decimus, sēptimus decimus are not followed.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
